_about: Voiceover lines, modelled on the 27M-view reel: short, calm, friendly lines that push likes, comments, shares and follows, one line that lets the viewer breathe, encouragement near the end and a one-word win on the last lung. Each reel takes one line per slot, preferring lines used least so far. Slots in reel order (57 s hold, 60 s reel): intro 0.3, like 4.7, comment 8.8, share 16.1, breathe 21.9, mid 31.2, follow 34.6, push 46.9, almost 49.2, done as the ball reaches the last lung (~56.6). Keep within maxWords (about 3 words per second).
